Desc_0.en: A free spirit not affiliated with any sect.
Desc_0.ru: Свободный Дух, не связанный ни с какой Сектой.

Desc_1.en: Shaolin is one of the most well-respected martial arts schools that upholds justice. The founder Bodhidharma, applied Chan to martial arts, and meditated in the temple for nine whole years. During his meditation he created the 72 Techniques, bringing Shaolin unprecedented might.
Desc_1.cn: 少林派乃正派武林中的泰山北斗。菩提达摩祖师以禅入武，在少林寺面壁九年，创出“七十二绝技”，无不冠绝天下。

Desc_2.en: Emei is one of the Three Great Sects in the martial world, also renowned as the birthplace of many martial arts. True to its name, Emei—the most graceful under heaven, boasts a mixed style of martial arts, where hardness and softness meet, Taoism and Buddhism melt, and serenity and wisdom match.
Desc_2.cn: 天下武功出峨眉。峨眉乃武林三大名宗之一。派如其名——“天下秀”。峨眉武学刚柔并济，道释相融，定慧双修。

Desc_3.en: The Valley of Flowers is renowned for its medical arts, especially its unparalleled acupuncture techniques. Its disciples are widely respected for their unmatched benevolence and righteousness.
Desc_3.cn: 百花谷以医术闻名天下，御针施灸之技法无比神妙。门人悬壶济世，仁义无双，多为世人所敬仰。
Desc_3.ru: Долина цветов славится своим медицинским искусством, особенно непревзойденными техниками иглоукалывания. Его ученики пользуются всеобщим уважением за их непревзойденную доброжелательность и праведность.

Desc_4.en: Wudang, along with Shaolin and Emei, is one of the Three Great Sects of martial arts. Wudang martial arts are profound and comprehensive, with a strong emphasis on Qi Art cultivation. Its founder, renowned for his deep Taoism and Taiji techniques, was admittedly the foremost master of Qi Art in the world.
Desc_4.cn: 与少林、峨眉并称武林三大名宗。武当派武功博大精深，最重内功修养，创派祖师真君道法高深，太极神功名满天下，堪称天下内家功法第一。

Desc_5.en: The Yuanshan Sect boasts numerous disciples, all dedicated to upholding justice in the martial arts world. At Greater Yuanshan, they follow Taoism and have a Blade Mound, while at Lesser Yuanshan, they follow Buddhism and have a Sword Mound. Disciples in Greater & Lesser Yuanshan are deeply connected, and with their divine techniques of blade and sword united, they exorcise demons and protect the righteous, earning themselves a heroic reputation far and wide.
Desc_5.cn: 元山派弟子众多，以维护武林正道为己任。大元山修道，有一刀冢，小元山修佛，有一剑冢，大小元山同气连枝，以刀剑合壁之神技，除魔卫道，侠名远播。

Desc_6.en: The martial arts of the Lion-Face Clan epitomize brutal dominance. Though their Qi Art cultivation is rudimentary, their peerless Iron Skin allows them to smash metals and shatter stones—achieving near-immunity to blades, which represents the apex of all physical martial arts.
Desc_6.cn: 狮相门武学强横霸道，虽不重视内功修为，但横练硬气功独步天下，可开金断石，刀枪不入，堪称外家功法极致。

Desc_7.en: The Ranshan Sect specializes in two doctrines: Itinerant Scholarship and Transcendence. Itinerant Scholarship involves extensive learning, keen insight, and compelling eloquence that leaves no scope for refutation. Transcendence focuses on refining the mind and nurturing the spirit through meditation, alchemy, and breathwork, warding off illness and prolonging life until Ascension becomes attainable.
Desc_7.cn: 然山派专习游学出世之说。游学：广记多闻，明理审势，出词吐辩，万口莫当。出世：修真养性，服食引导，祛病延年，冲举可俟。

Desc_8.en: Jade-Maiden Peak, also known as Celestial Maiden Peak, is covered in Permafrost. Legend has it that a celestial maiden once descended upon this peak, leaving behind the Jade Disk of Egarim. Any woman who studies its secrets will attain unparalleled grace, translucent skin like jade, and the chance to ascend to immortality.
Desc_8.cn: 璇女峰又称玉女峰，峰上有玄冰。传说曾有天女降于峰上，并留下一部一明珏奇功，但凡女子修炼，便可清俊脱俗，冰肌玉骨，飞升成仙。

Desc_9.en: The Swordsmith Villa is located in the Mount Zhanlu. Legend has it that it was established by Ou Yezi, the founder of swordsmith. With a long history, the Swordsmith Villa is the home of most celestial weapons in the world, earning deep admiration from martial artists.
Desc_9.cn: 铸剑山庄位于湛卢山，相传乃是铸剑祖师欧冶子所创建。铸剑山庄源远流长，天下间的神兵利器，大多出于此地，深受武林中人的仰慕。

Desc_10.en: The Kongsang Sect, sometimes called the Prime Kongsang Sect, excels in both medicines and poisons. While Mt. Kongsang is covered in snow, its hidden realm teems with rare and wondrous herbs. Their medicines are capable of bringing back the dead, whereas their poisons kill without a trace.
Desc_10.cn: 空桑派又名空桑药王派。空桑山虽为雪山，却别有洞天，山中奇珍异草无所不有，空桑弟子药毒双绝，药可起死回生，毒可杀人无形。

Desc_11.en: The Vajra Sect is a Vajrayana branch hailing from the ancient Kingdom of Xang Xung. It boasts numerous disciples with peerless enforcer techniques yet ruthless and depraved conduct—markedly distinct from orthodox Vajrayana traditions, and universally reviled by righteous martial factions.
Desc_11.cn: 无量金刚宗乃传自古象雄王国的一支密教分支。金刚宗弟子众多，护法神功威力无比，但行事凶狠淫恶，与正统密宗大不相同，乃是正派武林人士之大敌。

Desc_12.en: The Five Venoms Sect of Miaojiang, self-titled as the Five Immortals Sect, upholds extremist doctrines of absolute retribution. Making poisons and breeding Gu, their grotesque methods cause universal dread—shunned by all martial factions, righteous and evil alike.
Desc_12.cn: 苗疆五毒教，自称五仙教，教义甚是极端，恩仇必报。教中炼毒，养蛊诸多奇诡之术，无不骇人听闻，武林中人无论正邪，无不避而远之。

Desc_13.en: The Veil Scar Sect, known as the place where ghosts walk with the living, harbors evildoers from across the Martial World. Its disciples operate in secrecy, rarely revealing their presence. They excel in the Qimen Dunjia as well as various concealed weapons. Once they set their sights on a target, death comes swiftly—unseen and inescapable.
Desc_13.cn: 界青门俗称人鬼同途之地，多收纳江湖恶徒。本门弟子行事隐秘，极少显露踪迹。门人最擅长奇门遁甲，飞针投石之术，倘若杀意一起，定教人死于无影无形。

Desc_14.en: The Fuloong Sanctuary stands upon Chiming Island in the East Sea. Within the sect, two lineages prevail: the Situ Clan with its peerlessly fierce blade arts, and the Long Clan with its profound fist arts. Legend speaks of active volcanoes on the island—their disciples cultivate Martial Arts in those fiery depths.
Desc_14.cn: 伏龙坛建于东海之上的赤明岛。伏龙坛中分为两脉：司徒氏一脉刀法刚猛无匹，龙氏一脉拳掌精深卓绝。相传岛上有火山，弟子皆于火山中修习功法。

Desc_15.en: Following the disorder brought about by Xiangshu, evildoers and renegades from across the world converged and created the Sanguine Sect. Its disciples learn to wield a chaotic form of magic, distorting their minds to an extent that not even Bodhisattva can save them. They are the greatest enemy of all the sects that have vowed to uphold justice.
Desc_15.cn: 相枢乱世以来，万恶之徒渐而聚首，创立了血犼教。教中魔功乱人本性，菩萨亦是难救，正派武林人士自然与其势不两立。

Desc_16.en: Life in the village is simple, if somewhat impoverished. It's peaceful, almost beyond belief; residents need not even lock their doors as they sleep the nights away soundly.
Desc_16.cn: 太吾村恪守出世之道，是极其清苦的地方。村中鸡犬相闻，夜不闭户，一派祥和，不似人间。
Desc_16.ru: Жизнь в деревне простая, хотя и несколько бедноватая. Здесь тихо, почти невероятно; жителям даже не нужно запирать свои двери, поскольку они крепко спят всю ночь напролет.

Desc_19.en: Creature of the blackstone that succumbed to demonic influences.
Desc_19.ru: Существо из блэкстоуна, поддавшееся демоническому влиянию.

Desc_20.en: A lost soul devoid of will, bound only to Xiangshu's command.
Desc_20.ru: Потерянная душа, лишенная воли, связанная только приказом Сяншу.

Desc_21.en: Jingji and its surrounding areas are immensely prosperous, bustling with merchants, officials, nobles and others from all over the land. This region stands as the very heart of wealth and power in the Central Plains.
Desc_21.cn: 京畿之地，极是富足，各地商贾官宦往来不绝，乃是中原财富与权势的中心。
Desc_21.ru: Цзинцзи и его окрестности чрезвычайно процветают, здесь много торговцев, чиновников, знати и других людей со всей страны. Этот регион является средоточием богатства и власти на Центральных равнинах.

Desc_22.en: Known as "the Heavenly Kingdom," Chengdu boasts its mild climate and outstanding local talent, and the Mt. Emei nearby is supposedly inhabited by immortals.
Desc_22.cn: 成都气候温和，地灵人杰，人称“天府之国”。传说蜀中峨眉山有神仙居住，非人间俗地。
Desc_22.ru: Известный как "Небесное царство", Чэнду может похвастаться своим мягким климатом и выдающимися местными Талантами, а близлежащая гора Эмэй, предположительно, населена бессмертными.

Desc_23.en: The landscape of Guizhou is picturesque beyond compare, long praised in traditional verses as 'Where scenery outshines the Central Plains' fair' and 'Guilin's mountains and waters lead the world nowhere.'
Desc_23.cn: 桂州山水如画，美不胜收，素有“江山清绝胜中原”、“桂林山水甲天下”之说。
Desc_23.ru: Ландшафт Гуйчжоу ни с чем не сравним по живописности, его издавна восхваляли в традиционных стихах как "Место, где пейзаж затмевает центральные равнины", "прекрасное" и "Горы и воды Гуйлиня ведут мир в никуда".

Desc_24.en: The name 'Xiangyang' comes from its position on the yang (north) bank of the Xiang River. Boasting formidable city walls and a strategic location connecting land and river routes, it has been a militarily vital stronghold since ancient times.
Desc_24.cn: 因位于“襄水之阳”故名“襄阳”。襄阳城城郭雄伟，水陆交通便利，是自古兵家必争之地。
Desc_24.ru: Название "Сянъян" происходит от его расположения на Ян (северном) берегу реки Сян. Обладая внушительными городскими стенами и стратегическим расположением, соединяющим сухопутные и речные маршруты, он с древних времен был жизненно важным в военном отношении оплотом.

Desc_25.en: As the old saying goes, 'Zhending dazzles in floral splendor, while Taiyuan rivals brocade in grandeur.' Encircled by mountains on three sides, Taiyuan's majestic landscape cements its status as the foremost stronghold of northern Central Plains.
Desc_25.cn: 所谓“花花真定府，锦绣太原城”。太原三面环山，极是壮丽，乃中原北方第一重镇。
Desc_25.ru: Как гласит старая поговорка, "Чжэньдин ослепляет цветочным великолепием, в то время как Тайюань соперничает по великолепию с парчой". Величественный ландшафт Тайюаня, окруженный горами с трех сторон, укрепляет его статус главной крепости северных Центральных равнин.

Desc_26.en: Guangzhou was fortified with three nested walled enclosures—the Yacheng (Administrative Citadel), Zicheng (Inner City), and Luocheng (Outer Enclosure)—which created a thriving hub for maritime traders and extraordinary talents from overseas.
Desc_26.cn: 广州筑有“牙城”、“子城”和“罗城”三城，外商云集，多有海外奇人异士往来。
Desc_26.ru: Гуанчжоу был укреплен тремя вложенными друг в друга крепостными стенами — Ячэн (Административная цитадель), Цзичэн (Внутренний город) и Луочэн (Внешняя ограда), которые создали процветающий центр для морских торговцев и выдающихся талантов из—за рубежа.

Desc_27.en: Qingzhou, one of the legendary 'Jiuzhou' in ancient China, has long been a strategic stronghold in eastern China. Its name derives from the Chinese tranditional belief that 'the east corresponds to Wood in the Five Elements system, and Wood is represented by the color green'—hence 'Qing' (green) 'zhou' (province).
Desc_27.cn: 上古“九州”之一，乃是东方重镇。因“东方属木，木色为青”，故称“青州”。

Desc_28.en: Jiangling, a "historic imperial capital" and strategic hub in the heart of the Central Plains, was once part of the Jing and Chu states. A cradle of culture and education, it attracts respected figures from across the land.
Desc_28.cn: 江陵乃是中原沟通西北东南的“帝王古都”。荆楚之地文教鼎盛，是风雅名士云集之地。
Desc_28.ru: Цзянлин, "историческая столица империи" и стратегический центр в самом сердце Центральных равнин, когда-то был частью государств Цзин и Чу. Являясь колыбелью культуры и образования, он привлекает уважаемых деятелей со всей страны.

Desc_29.en: Fuzhou has a large population and boasts a highly developed and prosperous maritime trading sector. Filled with Banyan trees, it's known as the Banyan City.
Desc_29.cn: 福州人口众多，海商十分发达，极是繁荣。因遍植榕树，所以人称“榕城”。
Desc_29.ru: Фучжоу имеет большое население и может похвастаться высокоразвитым и процветающим сектором морской торговли. Заросший баньяновыми деревьями, он известен как Баньяновый город.

Desc_30.en: Liaoyang governed vast territories as a strategic northern stronghold. As the north's most famous ancient capital, it has been the seat of power for numerous rulers.
Desc_30.cn: 辽阳辖地极广，是北方的重镇。作为北方最有名的古都，数度成为北方各国之京畿重地。
Desc_30.ru: Ляоян управлял обширными территориями как стратегический северный оплот. Будучи самой знаменитой древней столицей севера, он был средоточием власти многочисленных правителей.

Desc_31.en: Qinzhou lies at the edge of the land, which might be why its people are not the most civilized. Under the control of the Vajra Sect, it seems to have become the foundation for the restoration of the Kingdom of Xang Xung.
Desc_31.cn: 秦州乃边陲之地，民不开化。在金刚宗的掌控下，俨然已成为复辟古象雄王国的根基要地。
Desc_31.ru: Циньчжоу находится на краю земли, и, возможно, именно поэтому его жители не самые цивилизованные. Находясь под контролем Секты Ваджра, она, по-видимому, стала основой для восстановления королевства Шанг-Сюнг.

Desc_32.en: The people of Dali were known for their simple and honest ways, deeply devoted to Buddhism. Though the kingdom comprised many clans and tribes, all lived in harmony, creating a prosperous society.
Desc_32.cn: 大理国民风淳朴，笃信佛教。国内虽氏族部落众多，但皆团结友爱，呈现一派繁荣景象。
Desc_32.ru: Жители Дали были известны своими простыми и честными обычаями, глубоко преданными Буддизму. Хотя королевство состояло из множества кланов и племен, все они жили в гармонии, создавая процветающее общество.

Desc_33.en: Huainan's capital Shouchun, long hailed as the 'Strategic Gateway to the Central Plains,' holds dual cultural significance as both the ancestral homeland of the Chu people and the birthplace of tofu.
Desc_33.cn: 淮南以寿春为都，素有“中州咽喉”之称。寿春不仅是楚人故乡，亦是“豆腐”之乡。
Desc_33.ru: Столица Хуайнаня Шоучунь, долгое время считавшаяся "стратегическими воротами на Центральные равнины", имеет двойное культурное значение как родина предков народа Чу и родина тофу.

Desc_34.en: Hangzhou, eternally praised as 'Where hills and lakes bestow their grace, The premier city of the Southeast,' has served as the cosmopolitan heart of the Three Wu regions since antiquity, its prosperity enduring through the dynasties.
Desc_34.cn: “地有湖山美，东南第一州”说的即是杭州。杭州是三吴都会，自古繁华。
Desc_34.ru: Ханчжоу, вечно прославляемый как "Место, где холмы и озера дарят свое изящество, главный город Юго-востока", с древности служил космополитическим сердцем трех регионов У, его процветание продолжалось на протяжении династий.

Desc_35.en: Yangzhou's triple-city complex bustled with tourist boats, its nights alive with sheng music. As the poet wrote, 'The moon all the world adores, Yangzhou claims two-thirds.'
Desc_35.cn: 扬州一地三城，处处是画舫，夜夜有笙歌。所谓“天下三分明月夜，二分无赖是扬州”。
Desc_35.ru: Тройной городской комплекс Янчжоу кишел туристическими лодками, а по ночам здесь звучала музыка шэн. Как писал поэт, "Луна, которую обожает весь мир, Янчжоу претендует на две трети".

Desc_36.en: Smoke curls up from village chimneys, as dirt paths wind through fields and hedges.
Desc_36.cn: 村庄中袅袅升起炊烟。简易修整的泥土小径散布于田野与矮篱之间。
Desc_36.ru: Из деревенских труб вьется дымок, а грунтовые дорожки вьются между полями и живыми изгородями.

Desc_37.en: A populous town, connected to the main highway, thrived with roads radiating in all directions.
Desc_37.cn: 人口众多的城镇。因与大道相连，故而四通八达，颇为繁荣。
Desc_37.ru: Густонаселенный город, соединенный с главной магистралью, процветал благодаря дорогам, расходящимся во всех направлениях.

Desc_38.en: A land-and-water stronghold, fortified with walls and stockaded villages, housed self-sufficient communities who often asserted autonomous rule.
Desc_38.cn: 以围墙、关寨保护起来的水陆要隘。居民自给自足，往往占地为王。
Desc_38.ru: В крепости на суше и на воде, укрепленной стенами и обнесенными частоколом деревнями, проживали самодостаточные общины, которые часто утверждали автономное правление.

Desc_39.en: Those who overstep will meet their end.
Desc_39.ru: Те, кто переступит черту, встретят свой конец.

Desc_40.en: All beings have spirits; heaven and earth hold compassion.
Desc_40.ru: У всех существ есть Дух; небо и земля хранят сострадание.

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_1.en: A stone tablet carved with sutras, symbolizing the Path of Chan Arts.\nYears ago, the Shaolin Sect and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and save the people...
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_1.cn: 石上遍刻经文，象征着禅武之道的石碑。\n少林派与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，救世济民…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_1.ru: Каменная табличка с вырезанными на ней сутрами, символизирующая Путь искусств Чань.Несколько лет назад Секта Шаолинь и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и спасти народ...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_2.en: A white jade stone tablet symbolizing the harmony of Taoism and Buddhism.\nYears ago, the Emei Sect and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and save the people...
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_2.cn: 以白璧铸成，象征着道释相融的石碑。\n峨眉派与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，救世济民…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_2.ru: Табличка из белого Нефрита, символизирующая гармонию Даосизма и Буддизма.Несколько лет назад Секта Эмэй и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и спасти народ...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_3.en: A stone tablet ringed with fragrant herbs, symbolizing medical learners' compassion.\nYears ago, the Valley of Flowers and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and save the people...
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_3.cn: 以芳草环绕，象征着医者仁心的石碑。\n百花谷与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，救世济民…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_3.ru: Каменная табличка, окруженная ароматными Травами, символизирующая сострадание студентов-медиков.\Несколько лет назад Долина цветов и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и спасти людей...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_4.en: A stone tablet forged of Martial Arts stone, embodying orthodox Taoist principles.\nYears ago, the Wudang Sect and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and save the people...
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_4.cn: 以真武镇石铸就，象征着道门正意的石碑。\n武当派与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，救世济民…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_4.ru: Каменная табличка, выкованная из камня для Боевых искусств, воплощающая ортодоксальные даосские принципы.\Несколько лет назад Секта Удан и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и спасти народ...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_5.ru: Грубая каменная табличка с вырезанными на ней лезвиями и мечами, символизирующими мученичество во имя спасения.\Несколько лет назад Секта Юаньшань и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и спасти народ...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_7.ru: Мистическая каменная табличка, символизирующая Бессмертные врата.Несколько лет назад Секта Жаньшань и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и вырвать корень бедствия...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_9.ru: Каменная табличка в форме Меча, олицетворяющая мастерское мастерство.Несколько лет назад Кузнецы мечей и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и отсечь корень бедствия...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_10.ru: Каменная табличка в форме котла, символизирующая мастерство в медицине и Ядах.Несколько лет назад Секта Кунсан и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и вырвать корень бедствия...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_11.cn: 顶端奉有如意宝杵，象征着无上瑜伽的石碑。\n金刚宗与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，永绝后患…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_11.ru: Каменная табличка, увенчанная Ваджрой, символизирующая высшую йогу.Несколько лет назад Секта Ваджра и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и навсегда покончить с этим бедствием.

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_12.en: A stone tablet hung with sacred silver ornaments, embodying Miaojiang secret skills.\nYears ago, the Five Immortals Sect and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and end this scourge forever...
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_12.cn: 悬有圣女所佩银饰，象征着苗疆秘法的石碑。\n五仙教与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，永绝后患…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_12.ru: Каменная табличка, увешанная священными серебряными украшениями, олицетворяющими тайные навыки Мяоцзяна.Несколько лет назад Секта пяти Бессмертных и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и навсегда покончить с этим бедствием...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_13.cn: 两侧以面具为饰，象征着生死无常的石碑。\n界青门与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，永绝后患…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_13.ru: Украшенная маской каменная табличка, символизирующая непостоянство жизни и смерти.Несколько лет назад Секта Завесы и Преемник Тайу поклялись здесь искоренить Сяншу и покончить с этим бедствием навсегда...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_14.en: A golden Loong coiling around the stone tablet, embodying True Loong's Divine Art.\nYears ago, Fuloong Sanctuary and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and end this scourge forever...
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_14.cn: 金龙盘旋其上，象征着真龙神力的石碑。\n伏龙坛与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，永绝后患…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_14.ru: Золотой Лун, обвивающийся вокруг каменной таблички, олицетворяет Божественное искусство Истинного Луна. Несколько лет назад Святилище Усмиряет дракона и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и навсегда покончить с этим бедствием...

TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_15.en: A stone tablet sculpted like the a sanguine beast, symbolizing demonic cult supremacy.\nYears ago, Sanguine Sect and the Successor of Taiwu swore an oath here to eradicate Xiangshu and end this scourge forever.
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_15.cn: 仿血犼之貌塑成，象征着邪道魔首的石碑。\n血犼教与太吾传人多年前于此立誓，约定共除相枢，永绝后患…
TaiwuVillageSteleDesc_15.ru: Каменная табличка, изваянная в виде сангвинического зверя, символизирующего превосходство демонического культа.Несколько лет назад Багряная секта и Преемник Тайу дали здесь клятву искоренить Сяншу и навсегда покончить с этим бедствием.

OrganizationExtraDesc_1.en: Shaolin Sect is one of the most well-respected martial arts schools that upholds justice. The founder Bodhidharma, applied Chan to martial arts, and meditated in the temple for nine whole years. During his meditation he created the 72 Techniques, bringing Shaolin unprecedented might.\nShaolin Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_9>Polearm Arts (Staff). Known for the Path of Chan Arts, they integrate both internal and external cultivation, and strike a perfect balance between attack and defense. Every movement flows seamlessly, all guided by a mind as clear as a still pond.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Shaolin Sect is an established <color=#lightblue>Good</color> sect whose mindset follows the path of <color=#lightblue>Benevolence</color>. Home to many <color=#lightblue>Benevolent</color> individuals, they will not teach techniques to those with low Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_1.cn: 少林派乃正派武林中的泰山北斗。菩提达摩祖师以禅入武，在少林寺面壁九年，创出“七十二绝技”，无不冠绝天下。\n少林派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_9>长兵（棍法）组成，素有禅武之称，内外兼修，攻守兼备，诸般腾挪变化，系于一念净心。\n<color=#lightgrey>（少林派乃<color=#goodsect>正派名宗</color>；立场以<color=#lightblue>仁善</color>为主，寺中多<color=#lightblue>仁善</color>之士；不会向名誉过低之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_2.en: Emei is one of the Three Great Sects in the martial world, also renowned as the birthplace of many martial arts. True to its name, Emei—the most graceful under heaven, boasts a mixed style of martial arts, where hardness and softness meet, Taoism and Buddhism melt, and serenity and wisdom match.\nEmei Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_10>Exotic Weapons (Piercers). Their style is swift and fluid, balancing softness with strength. By incorporating the finest aspects of various sects and drawing inspiration from the myriad forms of the world, Emei has established itself as a grand martial tradition.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Emei Sect is an established <color=#lightblue>Good</color> sect whose mindset follows the path of <color=#lightblue>Benevolence</color>. Home to many <color=#lightblue>Benevolent individuals</color>, they will not teach techniques to those with low Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_2.cn: 天下武功出峨眉。峨眉乃武林三大名宗之一。派如其名——“天下秀”。峨眉武学刚柔并济，道释相融，定慧双修。\n峨眉派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_10>奇门（对刺）组成，迅捷灵动，亦柔亦刚，兼采各派所长，取法世间万类，俨然为大宗气象。\n<color=#lightgrey>（峨眉派乃<color=#goodsect>正派名宗</color>；立场以<color=#lightblue>仁善</color>为主，派中多<color=#lightblue>仁善</color>之士；不会向名誉过低之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_3.en: The Valley of Flowers is renowned for its medical arts, especially its unparalleled acupuncture techniques. Its disciples are widely respected for their unmatched benevolence and righteousness.\nValley of Flowers Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_12>Ranged Arts (Needle Boxes), and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_13>Instrument Arts. Originally rooted in medical practices, their expertise lies in acupuncture and moxibustion, skillfully unblocking meridians, revitalizing the body, and achieving rejuvenation. Life and death are not determined by fate, but lie within their control.\n<color=#lightgrey>(The Valley of Flowers is an established <color=#lightblue>Good</color> sect whose mindset follows the path of <color=#lightblue>Benevolence</color>. Home to many <color=#lightblue>Benevolent individuals</color>, they will not teach techniques to those with low Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_3.cn: 百花谷以医术闻名天下，御针施灸之技法无比神妙。门人悬壶济世，仁义无双，多为世人所敬仰。\n百花谷武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_12>御射（针匣）、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_13>乐器组成，本是医家刺灸之术，擅能通经活脉，枯木回春，死生非由命定，乃在于股掌之间。\n<color=#lightgrey>（百花谷乃<color=#goodsect>正派名宗</color>；立场以<color=#lightblue>仁善</color>为主，谷中多<color=#lightblue>仁善</color>之士；不会向名誉过低之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_4.en: Along with Shaolin and Emei, Wudang ranks among the Three Great Sects of martial arts. Wudang's discipline is profound, deeply focused on inner cultivation. Its founder possessed deep Taoist wisdom; his Taiji Divine Art is renowned everywhere—truly the pinnacle of internal disciplines.\nWudang Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_11>Whip Arts (Whisk). Their style emphasizes the fluidity of mind and the resonance of spirit. By overcoming the unyielding with the supple, and finding stillness within motion, one treads the true path of the Tao, acting in accordance with nature.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Wudang Sect is an established <color=#lightblue>Good</color> sect whose mindset follows the path of <color=#white>Moderation</color>. Home to many <color=#white>Moderate</color> individuals, they will not teach techniques to those with low Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_4.cn: 与少林、峨眉共称武林三大名宗之一。武当派武功博大精深，最重内功修养，创派祖师真君道法高深，太极神功名满天下，堪称天下内家功法第一。\n武当派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_11>软兵（拂尘）组成，讲求意随心生，气至力达，往往以柔克刚，以静制动，此正是道家真法，自然之理。\n<color=#lightgrey>（武当派乃<color=#goodsect>正派名宗</color>；立场以<color=#white>中庸</color>为主，派中多<color=#white>中庸</color>之士；不会向名誉过低之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_5.en: Yuanshan Sect boasts numerous disciples, all dedicated to upholding justice in the martial arts world. At Greater Yuanshan, they follow Taoism and have a Blade Mound, while at Lesser Yuanshan, they follow Buddhism and have a Sword Mound. Disciples in Greater & Lesser Yuanshan are deeply connected, and with their divine techniques of blade and sword united, they exorcise demons and protect the righteous, earning themselves a heroic reputation far and wide.\nYuanshan Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_5>Kicking Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>Blade Arts. Their forms are grand yet grounded in simplicity; though the techniques are many, they are bound by honor and measure, shining with a supreme light.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Yuanshan Sect is an established <color=#lightblue>Good</color> sect whose mindset follows the path of <color=#yellow>Principle</color>. Home to many <color=#yellow>Principled</color> individuals, they will not teach techniques to those with low Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_5.cn: 元山派弟子众多，以维护武林正道为己任。大元山修道，有一刀冢，小元山修佛，有一剑冢，大小元山同气连枝，以刀剑合壁之神技，除魔卫道，侠名远播。\n元山派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_5>腿法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>刀法组成，大开大阖，雄健质朴，虽则变化繁多，终是正大不阿，进退有节，若存无上光明。\n<color=#lightgrey>（元山派乃<color=#goodsect>正派名宗</color>；立场以<color=#yellow>刚正</color>为主，派中多<color=#yellow>刚正</color>之士；不会向名誉过低之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_6.en: The martial arts of Lion Face epitomize brutal dominance. Though their Qi Art cultivation is rudimentary, their peerless Iron Skin allows them to smash metals and shatter stones—achieving near-immunity to blades, which represents the apex of all Physical Arts.\nLion-Face Clan Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>Blade Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_9>Polearm Arts (Spear Arts); their techniques possess shattering momentum and a dominating ferocity—as if lifting mountains, they drive forward with irresistible might.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Lion-Face Clan is a <color=#white>Neutral</color> Sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#darkpurple>Rebelliousness</color>, and it is home to many <color=#darkpurple>Rebellious</color> individuals.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_6.cn: 狮相门武学强横霸道，虽不重视内功修为，但横练硬气功独步天下，可开金断石，刀枪不入，堪称外家功法极致。\n狮相门武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>刀法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_9>长兵（枪法）组成，势大力沉，刚猛霸道，犹如拔山扛鼎，一往而无前，有万夫莫当之威。\n<color=#lightgrey>（狮相门乃<color=#neutralsect>中立门派</color>；立场以<color=#darkpurple>叛逆</color>为主，门中多<color=#darkpurple>叛逆</color>之士。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_7.en: Ranshan Sect specializes in two doctrines: Itinerant Scholarship and Transcendence. Itinerant Scholarship involves extensive learning, keen insight, and compelling eloquence that leaves no scope for refutation. Transcendence focuses on refining the mind and nurturing the spirit through meditation, alchemy, and breathwork, warding off illness and prolonging life until Ascension becomes attainable.\nRanshan Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_10>Exotic Weapons (Talisman). Many of these techniques are secret Taoist arts. They grant mastery over wind and thunder, allowing the practitioner to command spirits and ghosts through methods that few can comprehend.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Ranshan Sect is a <color=#white>Neutral Sect</color>. Its mindset leans towards <color=#white>Moderation</color>, and it is home to many <color=#white>Moderate</color> individuals.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_7.cn: 然山派专习游学出世之说。游学：广记多闻，明理审势，出词吐辩，万口莫当。出世：修真养性，服食引导，祛病延年，冲举可俟。\n然山派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_10>奇门（符咒）组成，多为道门秘术，神妙无方，可以呼风召雷，驱神驭鬼，常人窥之难解其法。\n<color=#lightgrey>（然山派乃<color=#neutralsect>中立门派</color>；立场以<color=#white>中庸</color>为主，派中多<color=#white>中庸</color>之士。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_8.en: Jade-Maiden Peak, also known as Celestial Maiden Peak, is covered in Permafrost. Legend has it that a celestial maiden once descended upon this peak, leaving behind the Jade Disk of Egarim. Any woman who studies its secrets will attain unparalleled grace, translucent skin like jade, and the chance to ascend to immortality.\nJade-Maiden Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_13>Instrument Arts. Graceful and light, their bearing is one of exquisite enchantment. Their moves mimic the drift of mountain clouds, evoking the image of a celestial maiden descending to earth.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Jade-Maiden Sect is a <color=#white>Neutral Sect</color>. Its mindset leans towards <color=#yellow>Principle</color>, and it is home to many <color=#yellow>Principled</color> individuals. <color=#red>This sect strictly forbids disciples from marrying!</color>)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_8.cn: 璇女峰又称玉女峰，峰上有玄冰。传说曾有天女降于峰上，并留下一部一明珏奇功，但凡女子修炼，便可清俊脱俗，冰肌玉骨，飞升成仙。\n璇女派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_13>乐器组成，行止轻盈，风姿绰约，举动之间尽态极妍，望之如轻云出岫，恍然若仙子下凡。\n<color=#lightgrey>（璇女派乃<color=#neutralsect>中立门派</color>；立场以<color=#yellow>刚正</color>为主，派中多<color=#yellow>刚正</color>之士。<color=#red>此派严禁弟子婚配！</color>）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_9.en: Swordsmith Villa is located on Mount Zhanlu. Legend has it that it was established by Ou Yezi, the founder of swordsmith. With a long history, the Swordsmith Villa is the home of most celestial weapons in the world, earning deep admiration from martial artists.\nSwordsmith Villa Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>Blade Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_9>Polearm Arts (Staff Techniques), and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_12>Ranged Weapons (Mechanism). These arts trace their lineage back to the great swordsmith Ou Yezi. Renowned worldwide for their technical perfection, these techniques may achieve absolute supremacy when combined with a legendary weapon.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Swordsmith Villa is a <color=#white>Neutral</color> Sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#white>Moderation</color>, and it is home to many <color=#white>Moderate</color> individuals.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_9.cn: 铸剑山庄位于湛卢山，相传乃是铸剑祖师欧冶子所创建。铸剑山庄源远流长，天下间的神兵利器，大多出于此地，深受武林中人的仰慕。\n铸剑山庄武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>刀法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_9>长兵（杖法）、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_12>御射（机关）组成，传自欧祖试剑之法，以工巧闻于天下，若辅以神兵利器，更是威力绝伦。\n<color=#lightgrey>（铸剑山庄乃<color=#neutralsect>中立门派</color>；立场以<color=#white>中庸</color>为主，派中多<color=#white>中庸</color>之士。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_10.en: Kongsang Sect, also known as the Prime Kongsang Sect, excel in both medicines and poisons. Although Mt. Kongsang is a snow mountain, it has another world inside, teeming with rare and wondrous herbs. Their medicines can revive the dead, while their poisons strike without a trace.\nKongsang Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_5>Kicking Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>Concealed Weapons. Born from ancient Alchemical lore, these methods utilize deadly poisons and rare medicines to bolster one's constitution. By reshaping their very biology, practitioners reach a state of superhuman might, where no feat is beyond their reach.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Kongsang Sect is a <color=#white>Neutral Sect</color>. Its mindset leans towards <color=#red>Egocentricity</color>, and it is home to many <color=#red>Egocentric</color> individuals.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_10.cn: 空桑派又名空桑药王派。空桑山虽为雪山，却别有洞天，山中奇珍异草无所不有，空桑弟子药毒双绝，药可起死回生，毒可杀人无形。\n空桑派武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_5>腿法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>暗器组成，本源于黄白之术，擅用奇毒秘药以助功力，乃至于脱胎换骨，无所不能。 \n<color=#lightgrey>（空桑派乃<color=#neutralsect>中立门派</color>；立场以<color=#red>唯我</color>为主，派中多<color=#red>唯我</color>之士。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_11.en: The Vajra Sect is a Vajrayana branch hailing from the ancient Kingdom of Xang Xung. It boasts numerous disciples with peerless enforcer techniques yet ruthless and depraved conduct—markedly distinct from orthodox Vajrayana traditions, and universally reviled by righteous martial factions.\nVajra Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Blade Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_10>Exotic Weapons (Vajra Club), which harmonize as one through the Three Mysteries of Yoga. In offense, they strike with the fury of a Vajra; in defense, they stand firm like the Acalanatha; and in flow, they revolve like the Dharma Wheel.\n<color=#lightgrey>(The Vajra Sect is an <color=#red>Evil</color> Outlaw sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#red>Egocentric</color> views, and it is home to many <color=#red>Egocentric</color> individuals; they will not teach techniques to persons with too high Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_11.cn: 无量金刚宗乃传自古象雄王国的一支密教分支。金刚宗弟子众多，护法神功威力无比，但行事凶狠淫恶，与正统密宗大不相同，乃是正派武林人士之大敌。\n金刚宗武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>刀法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_10>奇门（短杵）组成，法效三密瑜伽，圆融一体，进取如金刚怒目，持守如明王不动，运行如宝轮圆转。\n<color=#lightgrey>（金刚宗乃<color=#evilsect>邪派外道</color>；立场以<color=#red>唯我</color>为主，派中多<color=#red>唯我</color>之士；不会向名誉过高之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_12.en: The Five Venoms Sect of Miao—or "Five Immortals Sect" as they style themselves—live by a brutal code of absolute retribution. Their practices of Poison Making and Gu-raising are bizarre and terrifying—everyone in the martial world avoids them.\nThe Five Immortals Sect's Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_11>Whip Arts. Born of Miao sorcery, these arts defy mortal comprehension. With the dreaded Poison Gu at their command, they strike fear into all who hear of them.\n<color=#lightgrey>(The Five Immortals Sect is an <color=#red>Evil</color> Outlaw sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#darkpurple>Rebelliousness</color>, and it is home to many <color=#darkpurple>Rebellious</color> individuals; they will not teach techniques to persons with too high Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_12.cn: 苗疆五毒教，自称五仙教，教义甚是极端，恩仇必报。教中炼毒，养蛊诸多奇诡之术，无不骇人听闻，武林中人无论正邪，无不避而远之。\n五仙教武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_11>软兵（鞭法）组成，秉自苗疆巫觋，其法诡秘莫测，更有独门毒蛊之术，世人闻之无不胆寒。\n<color=#lightgrey>（五仙教乃<color=#evilsect>邪派外道</color>；立场以<color=#darkpurple>叛逆</color>为主，教中多<color=#darkpurple>叛逆</color>之士；不会向名誉过高之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_13.en: The Veil Scar Sect, commonly known as the place where ghosts walk with the living, harbors evildoers from across the Martial World. Its disciples operate in secrecy, rarely revealing their presence. They excel in the Qimen Dunjia as well as the art of darting needles and stone-throwing. Once they set their sights on a target, death comes swiftly—unseen and inescapable.\nVeil Scar Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>Concealed Weapons, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>Sword Arts. Silent in motion yet swift as a thunderbolt, these moves are surgical and cold; they seek the instant kill, delivering death without a shred of mercy.\n<color=#lightgrey>(Veil Scar Sect is an <color=#red>Evil</color> Outlaw sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#darkpurple>Rebelliousness</color>, and it is home to many <color=#darkpurple>Rebellious</color> individuals; they will not teach techniques to persons with too high Reputation..)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_13.cn: 界青门俗称人鬼同途之地，多收纳江湖恶徒。本门弟子行事隐秘，极少显露踪迹。门人最擅长奇门遁甲，飞针投石之术，倘若杀意一起，定教人死于无影无形。\n界青门武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>暗器、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_7>剑法组成，往来悄然无踪，起势迅疾如电，发招凶狠利落，务以瞬息之间取人性命，绝无半分恻隐。\n<color=#lightgrey>（界青门乃<color=#evilsect>邪派外道</color>；立场以<color=#darkpurple>叛逆</color>为主，派中多<color=#darkpurple>叛逆</color>之士；不会向名誉过高之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_14.en: The Fuloong Sanctuary stands upon Chiming Island in the East Sea. Within the sect, two lineages prevail: the Situ Clan with its peerlessly fierce blade arts, and the Long Clan with its profound fist arts. Legend speaks of active volcanoes on the island—their disciples cultivate techniques in those fiery depths.\nFuloong Sanctuary Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>Concealed Weapons, and <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>Blade Arts. Drawing strength from spirits, these techniques grow exponentially more powerful. In a state of divine intoxication, the wielder can even command a tide of power—an unstoppable surge that can upend the seas and devour the heavens.\n<color=#lightgrey>(The Fuloong Sanctuary is an <color=#red>Evil</color> Outlaw sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#yellow>Principle</color>, and it is home to many <color=#yellow>Principled</color> individuals; they will not teach techniques to persons with too high Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_14.cn: 伏龙坛建于东海之上的赤明岛。伏龙坛中分为两脉：司徒氏一脉刀法刚猛无匹，龙氏一脉拳掌精深卓绝。相传岛上有火山，弟子皆于火山中修习功法。\n伏龙坛武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>暗器、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_8>刀法组成，其招式多借酒发力，酣醉之下，力道最是猛烈醇厚，大有倾江海、吞日月之势。\n<color=#lightgrey>（伏龙坛乃<color=#evilsect>邪派外道</color>；立场以<color=#yellow>刚正</color>为主，派中多<color=#yellow>刚正</color>之士；不会向名誉过高之人传授武学。）</color>

OrganizationExtraDesc_15.en: Following the disorder brought about by Xiangshu, evildoers and renegades from across the world converged and created the Sanguine Sect. Its disciples learn to wield a chaotic form of magic, distorting their minds to an extent that not even Bodhisattva can save them. They are the greatest enemy of all the sects that have vowed to uphold justice.\nSanguine Sect Martial Arts consist of <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>Fist Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>Finger Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_5>Kicking Arts, <SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>Concealed Weapons. These arts are all evil and underhand, using extreme measures—even sacrificing human blood as an offering to walk the Path of Mara, transforming life essence into forbidden power that defies death.\n<color=#lightgrey>(The Sanguine Sect is an <color=#red>Evil</color> Outlaw sect. Its mindset leans towards <color=#red>Egocentricity</color>, and it is home to many <color=#red>Egocentric</color> individuals; they will not teach techniques to persons with too high Reputation.)</color>
OrganizationExtraDesc_15.cn: 相枢乱世以来，万恶之徒渐而聚首，创立了血犼教。教中魔功乱人本性，菩萨亦是难救，正派武林人士自然与其势不两立。\n血犼教武学由<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_3>拳掌、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_4>指法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_5>腿法、<SpName=mousetip_gongfa_6>暗器组成，皆是邪诡恶毒，无所不用其极，甚或以人牲血祭，入于魔罗之道，而成不死邪功。\n<color=#lightgrey>（血犼教乃<color=#evilsect>邪派外道</color>；立场以<color=#red>唯我</color>为主，教中多<color=#red>唯我</color>之士；不会向名誉过高之人传授武学。）</color>

VowSpecialHint_13.en: The Veil Scar Sect's story remain inaccessible for now. The Prestige requirement for reaffirming support with them cannot be reduced yet.
VowSpecialHint_13.ru: История Секты завесы пока остается недоступной. Требование Престижа для подтверждения Поддержки с их стороны пока не может быть снижено.
